text:
𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗥 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗞𝗘𝗦 𝗜𝗡 𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧! 🏏🇮🇳

Gurnoor Brar (Test cap 321) gets Conway lbw for his first Test wicket, last ball before lunch.
NZ openers had put on 77 without loss.

Brar's debut so far? 👇
#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗥 𝗞𝗔 𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧 𝗪𝗜𝗖𝗞𝗘𝗧! 🏏🇮🇳

👉 Gurnoor Brar ne Test debut par Conway ko lbw kiya, lunch se theek pehle aakhri ball par
👉 Isse pehle NZ ke openers 77 run bina wicket ke jod chuke the (Latham 42)
👉 Gill ne toss jeet kar pehle bowling chuni

Kya Brar India ko Christchurch mein series jeeta payega?
